name: wal_writer_flush_after
description: Number of WAL bytes written by the WAL writer that triggers an immediate flush to disk.
symptoms: Excessive WAL flush frequency causing high I/O latency
Unnecessary disk writes under low-throughput workloads
Delayed WAL persistence increasing crash recovery time
Inefficient use of WAL buffer space
tuning_tips: Increase for write-heavy workloads with fast storage to reduce flush frequency; decrease (or set to 0) for strict durability requirements or when synchronous_commit is off. Monitor pg_stat_bgwriter.wal_written and wal_fpi_rate to assess impact.
